'''Francis Kelly''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kelly started work for the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where his only role was [[Porter]], a group of cruise ship guides in the [[Decolore Islands]].
